title: Author Burnout Signal
scenario: Flag authors whose article output has decreased for 3 consecutive months.
correctQuery: SELECT author_id FROM (SELECT author_id, mon, cnt, LAG(cnt) OVER(PARTITION BY author_id ORDER BY mon) as p1, LAG(cnt, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY author_id ORDER BY mon) as p2 FROM (SELECT author_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', publish_date) as mon, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM articles GROUP BY author_id, mon) t) t2 WHERE cnt < p1 AND p1 < p2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (author_id INT, publish_date DATE);
